## Changes

- Show loading, connection, and server errors separately from an empty library. Failed requests offer a Retry button instead of displaying setup instructions for an empty collection.
- Preserve the displayed games, cover images, and search when a refresh fails. The interface reports a successful refresh only after the request succeeds.
- Keep the last successfully indexed library when a manual or scheduled rescan fails. Failed forced refreshes return HTTP 503, and concurrent scans are serialized while existing library requests continue using the previous index.
- Update the Go builder and Alpine runtime images, and apply available Alpine package updates during image builds.
- Run the container as the unprivileged `gameshelf` account, UID `10001` and GID `10001`. Support existing non-root host identities and supplementary groups through Docker settings.
- Correct the Traefik example to use the default internal port, `8080`, and document custom port configuration and collection permissions.

## Release packages

- Separate experimental Edge packages from manually published stable releases. Stable packages require verification of the exact main source commit before publication.
- Include the Docker image archive, source archive, version-specific Compose file, license, release notes, build metadata, and SHA-256 checksums. Development tests and verification reports stay outside the public release bundle.
- Keep maintainer instructions and stable release helpers under `.github/`; the main README remains focused on installation and usage.

## Upgrade notes

The container previously ran as root. Before upgrading, ensure UID/GID `10001:10001` can read the mounted collection and search every game directory. Alternatively, configure Docker's `user` or `group_add` settings for an existing identity with access. A read-only mount prevents writes but does not grant read permission.

Keep the collection mounted read-only and retain `no-new-privileges:true`. The image supports a read-only container filesystem with all Linux capabilities dropped. It does not interpret `PUID` or `PGID` environment variables. See the README's container permissions section for examples.

For Traefik deployments using the default GameShelf listener, use `http://gameshelf:8080`. Changing the published host port alone does not change that internal address.

## Limitations

- Container packages currently support Linux amd64 only.
